$comment: Generated by base-camp lib/merge-settings.mjs, plus two entries that generator drops but the shared template/.claude/settings.json carries: Read(./**/id_rsa) and Bash(cd:*). The .env rules were narrowed on 2026-08-19 so CLAUDE.md's .env.local policy can actually run: the old catch-all Read(./.env.*) also matched .env.local.example, so the builder could not read the template it is told to copy from, and a Read deny blocks Write too, so it could not create the file either. The catch-all is replaced by Next.js's own enumerated env filenames (.env plus the development/production/test pairs it documents as its load order), with staging and preview added because this app deploys to Vercel and people hand-create those; that keeps every secret-bearing variant denied while leaving the .example files readable. KNOWN GAP: an env file under some other name — .env.ci, .env.qa — is no longer covered by any rule, where the catch-all did cover it. Add the name here if you start using one. .env.local itself moved to 'ask' so creating and filling it costs one approval and reading a populated one is a prompt the owner sees. 'ask' was previously empty only because the shared settings asked before git push, which would contradict the main-line rule in HOW-TO-BUILD.md — see guardrails/PROVENANCE.md. That reason does not apply to these three entries, and no push ask has been added.
